description: This file contains extension methods for configuring DynamoDB reminder storage options in the Orleans framework, specifically parsing connection strings to set various configuration properties.

classes.name: DynamoDBReminderStorageOptionsExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to configure DynamoDB reminder storage options via connection string parsing.

methods.name: ParseConnectionString
methods.description: Parses a connection string to set properties on DynamoDBReminderStorageOptions, such as Service, SecretKey, AccessKey, ReadCapacityUnits, WriteCapacityUnits, UseProvisionedThroughput, CreateIfNotExists, and UpdateIfExists.
